column3: “Leaders of the fathers” is rendered “leaders of the fathers’ households.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “so many … they.”
“The holy of holies” is rendered “the most holy place.”
“A house of loftiness” is rendered “a lofty house.”
“With the heart” is rendered “in the heart.”
“Who comes out from your loins” is rendered “who shall be born to you.”
“Will not be cut off to you” is rendered “You shall not lack,” and “descendants” as “sons.”
“The heavens of the heavens” is rendered “the highest heaven.”
“You will turn” is rendered “have regard,” and “cry of entreaty” as “cry.”
